Name: Shoplift Ridgeside Village
Author: TheMightyAmondee
Description:
[size=6]Shoplift Ridgeside Village
[/size][size=3]
A content pack to allow the shops added by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] to be shopliftable locations. Featuring unique dialogue for the Ridgeside Village shopkeepers (and a few others) if they notice you stealing their goods.[/size]

[size=3]The shops made shopliftable by this mod include:[/size]

[size=3]- Blooming Hill seed shop
- Heaps convenience store
- Pika's restaurant 
- Nightingale Orchard shop
- Malaya's pastry shop

You can be banned from all shops except Pika's restaurant if you're not careful![/size]

[size=4][b]Installation:[/b]
[/size]
[size=3]This is a content pack for Shoplifter. Shoplifter 1.2.4 or later must be installed for this mod to be used.[/size]

[size=3]1. Download the mod. It will download as a .zip file[/size]
[size=3]2. Unzip the downloaded .zip file[/size]
[size=3]3. Move the unzipped file to your Mods folder[/size]
[size=3]4. Enjoy! - and don't get caught![/size]

[size=4][b]Uninstalling:[/b]
[/size]
[size=3]Remove the mod from your Mods folder. Simple!

[b]Translations currently available in:
[/b]
- English by me
- Japanese thanks to hachihina!

[/size][size=4][b]See also:[/b]

[/size][size=3]A very big thank you to [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/Rafseazz]Rafseazz[/url] for allowing me to create this compatibility content pack for Ridgeside Village!

Don't have Shoplifter yet? You can download it [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8569]here[/url]![/size]
